observed_failure: empty_selection_signals_eof expected Complete immediately after closing its writer, but pump returned Pending during a parallel workspace test run; focused rerun passed.
mechanism: A pipe reader returns EAGAIN while any duplicated/inherited writer remains open. CLOEXEC only closes a child descriptor at exec, so a concurrent spawn can delay EOF beyond the parent writer close.
deterministic_regression: Duplicate the writer with F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, finish the empty payload, assert original writer FD is gone, reader remains Pending and poll reports no readiness; close the duplicate and require Complete under the absolute deadline.
change: Empty/exact-full EOF tests wait for poll readiness and honor the reader deadline. Production pump implementation is unchanged; its immediate-EOF documentation is corrected.
commands: 100 sequential runs of the clipboard integration-test executable with --test-threads=8, each with a30-second process timeout
